fixtures.name: gif-timing
fixtures.description: Six full frames of 0, 1, 2, 5, 10 and 25 hundredths, looping for ever: 0 and 1 count 100 ms.

fixtures.name: gif-plays-once
fixtures.description: No loop extension: plays once and holds its last frame.

fixtures.name: gif-plays-three
fixtures.description: Loop count 2: plays three times.

fixtures.name: gif-compositing
fixtures.description: Partial frames with transparency and disposal none, background, previous and unspecified.

fixtures.name: gif-disposal-previous-first
fixtures.description: A first frame disposed to previous, which is the empty canvas.

fixtures.name: gif-interlaced
fixtures.description: An interlaced 8x8 frame whose rows each have their own colour, then a plain frame.

fixtures.name: gif-code-sizes
fixtures.description: Frames compressed with minimum code sizes 2 to 8, each with a local table of that size.

fixtures.name: gif-table-full-clear
fixtures.description: A 64x64 noise frame that fills the 4096 code table, which the encoder clears.

fixtures.name: gif-table-full-no-clear
fixtures.description: The same noise with a full table that is never cleared: later codes reuse the full table.

fixtures.name: gif-truncated
fixtures.description: The data of the second frame stops half way and the file ends there.

fixtures.name: gif-frame-beyond-screen
fixtures.description: A second frame placed partly outside the logical screen.

fixtures.name: gif-no-colour-table
fixtures.description: Neither a global nor a local colour table.

fixtures.name: gif-zero-size-frame
fixtures.description: A frame of zero width between two full frames.

fixtures.name: gif-index-beyond-table
fixtures.description: Indices up to 7 against a local colour table of two entries.

fixtures.name: gif-invalid-code-size
fixtures.description: A second frame declaring a minimum code size of 12.

fixtures.name: gif-disposal-four
fixtures.description: A square with disposal method 4, then a pixel drawn over what the disposal left.

fixtures.name: gif-first-frame-beyond-screen
fixtures.description: A first frame larger than the 2x2 logical screen.

fixtures.name: gif-zero-screen
fixtures.description: A logical screen of 0x0 holding two full frames.

fixtures.name: gif-phase
fixtures.description: Eight frames of 200 ms whose index is drawn as opaque and clear cells inside an opaque ring.

fixtures.name: gif-phase-red
fixtures.description: The same eight frames in red, to tell an incoming picture from the outgoing one.

fixtures.name: webp-timing
fixtures.description: Six full frames of 0, 10, 15, 33, 100 and 250 ms, looping for ever: 0 and 10 count 100 ms.

fixtures.name: webp-plays-two
fixtures.description: Loop count 2: plays twice.

fixtures.name: webp-compositing
fixtures.description: Partial frames with and without blending and disposed to the background.
